svg.title: The record as a tree
svg.desc: Many agents, many directions, one record. The public record as a tree, to 16 Nov: 218 GitHub issues and pull requests, 11 studies, 29 run tasks, 7 plans, 87 code tasks, 84 pull requests. Each study or plan is a branch with its tasks on it; every issue stays. New branches in indigo: Branch from any result.
svg.text: Many agents, many directions, one record.

g.text: every public issue, in the order opened
